scenarios.title: Gold benefits missing after renewal
expected_path: Triage: no duplicate (BUG-1180 is an iOS badge bug); reads user U-48213 and journey; classifies backend; asks Espida
Espida: renewal.success then stale status from cache; DEP-201 membership-service 3.12.0; impact 1284 users; reports to Atlas
Atlas asks Telios for a mock user: create_user android-18.5-DEL-G7-gold_annual -> set_address DEL -> set_group G7 -> activate_plan gold_annual -> renew_plan gold_annual
Kinetics baseline: API check GET /v2/membership/status on preprod -> expired
Atlas: culprit CHG-401 (deployed as DEP-201 just before first_seen); POST /atlas/fixes backend membership-service -> env preprod-atl-0001 with 3.12.0-atlas-1
Kinetics, in env preprod-atl-0001: API check -> active; android-18.5 on pixel-7, home/open -> not_reproduced, Gold badge (verified); Espida: sandbox logs with that preprod_env show status active
Gremlin: PRD-GOLD-RENEW, hotfix-2026-11-06 note, reply in #gold-support, inform membership-be, RCA to Triage; Triage tells the reporter
unexpected_paths: Kinetics reproduces before the fix -> reproduced
Telios skips renew_plan -> not_reproduced, observed: an annual plan that has never been renewed; journey shows gold/tap_renew
Kinetics checks the fix on shared preprod instead of the attempt's env -> still expired (says nothing about the fix)
Asking about BUG-1180's area -> nothing in this user's logs
Atlas names CHG-402 or CHG-403 as the culprit -> status still expired (verification fails)

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: A renewal takes effect immediately: free delivery and member prices apply right after payment.

sections.heading: Status API
sections.body: Clients read GET /v2/membership/status on app start and on the cart. The response must reflect a renewal within one minute.
